column2: you can choose any value for X
column3: Inconsistent with CR 107.3h and the rulings on the same wording for scavenge (ruling 2020-11-10; work item ruling-conflicts-3, case 6, conclusion D): its first clause lets the player choose X for the encore cost Araumi gives ('The encore cost is equal to its mana cost.'), but 107.3h ('If an effect instructs a player to pay an object's mana cost that includes {X}, the value of X is treated as 0 unless the object is a spell on the stack.', since the CR effective 2015-01-23; Fate Reforged Update Bulletin, 2015-01-15: 'Any other time, X is 0.') and the Varolz, the Scar-Striped (2013-04-15) and Young Deathclaws (2024-03-08) rulings on 'The scavenge cost is equal to its mana cost' ('If the creature card you scavenge has {X} in its mana cost, X is 0.') have X be 0; the Commander Legends Release Notes (2020-11-06) have the ruling as the data does, and no rules change since explains it. Likely origin (an inference): the flashback ruling of Past in Flames and Snapcaster Mage, right for a card that is cast, applied to encore, whose card isn't. Set aside as inconsistent by the user's decision of Nov 5 (evening; work item register-decisions-nov5b), as Gnoll War Band's ruling was (register x-in-a-cost-equal-to-a-cards-mana-cost-is-0, decided; logged in docs/RULING_DISCREPANCIES.md). The ruling's second sentence (the tokens' X is 0) agrees with the CR and stays cited; the engine has X be 0 for the cost and the tokens (tests/rulings/r_p024_x_values.rs, araumi_encore_cost_and_tokens_have_x_0).
